name: Hollow Ground
description:
Exhume decaying corpses at will. When you walk over a decaying corpse, reduce the Cooldown of Undead Surge and Corpse Explosion by 1s, restore a portion of your max Health and Mana.

• Enemy gods and the Fire Giant can destroy corpses with 2 Attacks
• You can have up to 6 corpses (max duration); placing more removes the oldest

name: Undead Surge
description: Raise up to two decaying corpses from the underworld that surge forward, exploding on contact, at max range, or when you reactivate Undead Surge, dealing Magical Damage. Enemies hit are Slowed and have their Healing reduced for a duration. Corpses collapse after exploding and remain behind.

name: Corpse Explosion
description: Cause the target area to explode, dealing Magical Damage. Corpse Explosion also detonates any decaying corpses in the area, each dealing additional Magical Damage.

name: Fleeting Breath
description: Throw a charm from the underworld that awakens a decaying corpse, applying miasma to enemies in an area. The corpse falls to the ground and remains behind. Enemies take Magical Damage over time. After the duration, enemies that healed while they had this effect take Magical Damage and are Stunned.

name: Empty the Crypts
description:
Unleash a field of spirits at a target location for 6s. Enemies inside the field take Magical Damage every 0.5s.

• Each tick applies stacking Healing Reduction and Damage Dealt reduction (stacks refresh)
• After casting this ability, your next 3 Attacks also launch zombies that leave decaying corpses behind

name: Ah Puch Basic Attack
description: Fire a projectile that deals Magical Damage to the first enemy hit.
